pictures.name: TL1-Village-Edge
pictures.prompt: A dusty road at the edge of a small stone village among the hills of Galilee and Samaria in the first century, olive trees, low stone walls. Far off by a wall stand ten men in worn hooded cloaks of brown, grey and blue, keeping their distance, hands raised as they call out. In the foreground, a figure in a simple cream robe and brown mantle, seen only from behind, face never shown, walks with a few followers in simple robes. Late afternoon gold light, long shadows. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
